Planet R-12 is a sidescroller shooting game with no platforming where you can play as one of three squad members and/or select where each one is and let them fight by themselves. Possible DPI scale issues making things looked too zoomed in or out so you'll have to go into properties if it happens to you. Explanations in this guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2566075839 Replace the mentions of "N++" with "Planet R-12". Don't allow access to your network when the game starts for security reasons. You don't need to anyway. The multiplayer is broken (grayed out in main menu) but the achievements worked well. 

Planet R-12 plays with mouse for aiming and keyboard for movement, no gamepad support. I had trouble with the control scheme until I realized there were keyboard shortcuts for the special attacks, something which should have been shown in the training. The graphics looked like a Flash game, a bit amateurish but were clean. The robots were varied and looked nice. The animations looked like puppets moving. Cool you could select members of your squad from among 7 choices. Intros for big boss monsters were way too long and could not be skipped, especially the giant eye. For the cheap price, it's a decent little distraction for close to 2 hours.

"Планета Шелезяка. Воды нет. Растителности нет. Полезных ископаемых нет. Населена роботами." 

Фантастические мультфильмы всегда будоражили наше детское воображение. Я вот лет в десять под влиянием и Шелезяки, и "Войны гоботов" вообразил как-то раз планету, населенную механическими обитателями. Были там и разумные роботы, естественно, в том числе и трансформирующиеся - но особенно примечательно было то, что фауна тоже была механической. Неясно, откуда они там взялись - эти робоящеры, робозвери и робочудовища, - не помню, были ли в этом мире органические формы жизни. Но "картинка" была яркой и интересной. 

И вот попалась игра, довольно-таки сильно похожая на мою детскую фантазию. Группа землян - все, как на подбор, бравые вояки, - очутилась в странном механическом мире, где даже растения и насекомые искусственные. И все аборигены и вся фауна настроены крайне враждебно... Вся игра - одно красочное и динамичное приключение, не требующее при этом какого-либо напряжения. Ну, разве что с финальным боссом придется повозиться, покуда не поймете правильную тактику. 

Жаль только, короткая. Я, победив наконец последнего босса: ну всё, готовы дальше идти! Раз эту дылду одолели - ещё и не такое одолеем! И тут же обнаружил, что это был финал. 

Еще недостаток - альтернативное оружие есть не у всех бойцов, и оно хуже основного. И "мечник" почти бесполезен, когда находится под самоуправлением: бьет только тех врагов, что подошли вплотную.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Planet R-12 is a somewhat unusual hybrid of 2D side scrolling shooter and RTS where you control a squad of soldiers and move them around, letting them autoshoot stuff and sometimes using special abilities if you feel like micromanaging them.  It's a concept that might even have worked well if it was backed by a quality technical implementation.  Planet R-12 does not have a quality technical implementation.  There's a kitcshy sci-fi robot whatever theme that's badly expressed and badly translated to English, so we'll give that component of the game a miss.

One important note is that even though this is an amateur project, it does seem to be sincerely and genuinely made.  I couldn't find any flipped assets, plagiarism or any other kind of insincere actions from the developer, but unfortunately genuine intentions alone are not enough to produce a brilliant PC gaming experience.

From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

The artwork here is terrible, it's a hodge-podge of amateurish "My First Wacom Tablet" style drawings used instead professional looking game assets.  In some places it barely looks better than MS-paint.  It's unclear if this is due to lack of budget to arrange someone who can create graphical assets properly, or lack of talent, regardless, the overall visual quality of the game is extremely low, enough on its own to deter gamers.

There's no option to change the resolution and no useful graphics tweaks.  There's no way to ensure this is running at the native resolution of your display.  There's no guarantee this game will look right on any PC as a result of this hamfisted design decision.

It's apparent that little to no testing for the game was done, at least on modern gaming PCs.  In fullscreen, the game doesn't display properly, with the game area drawn outside the viewable space.  This is caused by the developer not bothering to ensure the game works on resolutions over 1080p, with very high resolution monitors that use resolution scaling.  Because the game area is not drawn correctly, it doesn't map to the mouse pointer properly, so the game itself simply cannot be played.  Gamers shouldn't be forced to accept defective products just because developers don't bother with basic testing on PC.

Some of the defects in the game can be attributed to the choice of using the video game toolset, ZenGL.  This is a very poor quality toolset, it's not even that easy to use, and thus rarely gets used in lieu of even more dumbed down construction kits like GameMaker Studio.  Also, unfortunately, it has very limited capabilities.  Just as you can't make a silk purse out of a sows ear, you can't make a great video game if you use a terrible engine.

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

You don't have to take my word about how bad the game is, we can measure the interest in a game by how much people bothered to play it.  Planet R-12 has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the game absolutely failed to capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is for getting to the end of the first level, trivial to achieve, but less than 3 percent of players bothered to get that far before uninstalling the game.  That's a tiny, tiny proportion of gamers who even bothered with this.  Ouch.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show less than 3 percent of players bothered playing the game for any reasonable amount of time.  How is it possible for this game to have so many concurrent players who didn't bother engaging with this game?  Trading cards.  People will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.

That tells us people only really bought this game for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

While this is cheap, it's not great.  There's worse value for money buying an cheap game you won't play for more than 5 minutes versus a more expensive AAA game that you'll get hundreds of hours of enjoyment from.

Very fun 2D Tactical Shooter,
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You control your squad by either double clicking where you want them to move to or by controlling an individual member (you can switch between them by pressing the num keys or scrolling the mouse wheel).
The squad automatically attack enemies when not controlled and move back and forth as necessary (Snipers moving to the back, etc.).

You also have access to three main skills: The first of which freezes enemies, the second shields a squad member, and the third calls in a drone to fight alongside you.
There are several diffrent squad members to choose from and each have their own abilities and weapons, so choosing the right characters for the job adds an extra layer to the fun. You may also pick up upgrades for squad members and unlock new weapons for them.

The enemies are rather interesting and several pose a challenge, so you will need to use all the skills available to you.
There are three different difficulty levels to choose from if you find the game too difficult or two easy, although I find the default difficulty to be just right.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Definitely recommend this game to anyone who is even slightly interested.

《Planet R-12》这款星际探险游戏，原本以其独特的科幻背景和探险玩法吸引了不少玩家的目光。然而在我实际体验这款游戏后，却发现它并未能达到预期的效果，反而暴露出了一些令人失望的问题。

首先从游戏的剧情和故事线来看，显得相当薄弱和缺乏深度。游戏试图通过星际探险的设定来构建一个庞大的世界观，但实际上却未能成功。故事情节平淡无奇，角色塑造也显得单薄，缺乏足够的个性和情感表达。这使得玩家在探险过程中难以对故事产生共鸣，也无法真正沉浸在游戏的世界中。

其次游戏的玩法机制同样令人失望。探险环节设计得过于简单和重复，缺乏足够的挑战性和趣味性。玩家在探索星球的过程中，往往只是进行简单的收集任务和战斗，没有太多的策略性和深度。同时游戏中的战斗系统也显得单调乏味，缺乏多样性和创新性，使得玩家在战斗过程中感到枯燥无味。

在游戏的画面和音效方面同样未能达到玩家的期待。虽然游戏试图通过科幻风格的画面来营造星际探险的氛围，但整体画面质量却显得较为粗糙，缺乏细节和精致度。音效方面也显得单调乏味，背景音乐和环境音效都缺乏真实感和沉浸感，无法为玩家营造出恰当的氛围和情绪。

此外游戏的稳定性和优化问题也令人头疼。我在游玩过程中多次遇到卡顿、延迟和崩溃等现象，这不仅影响了游戏的流畅性，也破坏了玩家的游戏体验。尤其是在进行复杂任务和激烈战斗时，这些问题更是频繁出现，让人无法忍受。

最后从性价比的角度来看同样未能给玩家带来物超所值的体验。相较于其他同类游戏，它在剧情、玩法、画面和音效等方面都显得较为逊色，但价格却并不亲民。这使得玩家在购买时可能会感到不值，尤其是对于期待高质量游戏体验的玩家来说。

综上所述，在剧情、玩法、画面、音效、稳定性以及性价比等方面都未能满足玩家的期待。如果你对这款游戏抱有较高的期望，或者希望寻找一款更具深度和趣味性的星际探险游戏，那么这款游戏可能并不适合你。希望开发者能够在未来的作品中认真倾听玩家的反馈，不断改进和完善游戏的设计，为玩家带来更好的游戏体验。
